sections: Intuition — A proportion of the list, not a probability of any mistake
Definition — The ratio, with an empty list counted as zero
Properties — Family-wise control is the stronger demand
Worked example — Four ordered p-values at level 0.1
Connections — Bonferroni, the step-up line, and power
Check yourself — Reading the step-up rule
sources_read: Hastie, Tibshirani and Friedman, ESL 2nd ed., pp. 687–688, equations 18.43 and 18.45, Algorithm 18.2
proofs: Q ≤ 1_{V≥1}, hence FDR ≤ FWER, with equality under the complete null.
skipped: Benjamini and Hochberg (1995) and Benjamini and Yekutieli (2001) were not opened. The independence bound is quoted from ESL, which calls the argument complicated.
